FFmpeg - license notice (bundled with BYTEPLUS for Maya, Windows)
=================================================================

This product bundles "ffmpeg.exe", a build of FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org),
run as a separate program to transcode Maya playblasts to H.264 MP4 and to
join / trim video clips for the Seedance video features.

LICENSE
-------

--enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree, so it is licensed under the GNU Lesser
General Public License version 3 or later (LGPL-3.0-or-later). FFmpeg is free
software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the LGPL
as published by the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License,
or (at your option) any later version.

FFmpeg is distributed WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty
of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the LGPL for
details. A full copy of the LGPL version 3 license text is included alongside

    https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html

    https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

BUILD / SOURCE
--------------
Bundled build: BtbN FFmpeg-Builds, "win64-lgpl" (static).
Version: N-125350-g3f6bf150cb-20260629
SHA-256 of ffmpeg.exe:
  6ef145b645c393dd1e4d0f987558d54699c6bc3fef788b1aa7bbe12e2c3ec112
  Builds:  https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases
The complete corresponding source code for this FFmpeg version is available at:
  https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds   (build scripts)
  https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git       (FFmpeg source; commit 3f6bf150cb)
  https://ffmpeg.org/download.html        (release tarballs)

The bundled ffmpeg.exe is unmodified. You may replace it with your own build
of FFmpeg at the same path (BYTEPLUS/bin/win/ffmpeg.exe).
